owner_instruction.statement: Do you remember the Eagles plays I sent you the ones I told you not to include in the madden model, I want you to include them. ... For Lions, CPU, ... I want the custom playbooks I will give you plays for the model to call out of those. For Chiefs and Titans the model should call the plays exactly as are.
owner_instruction.source_material: Owner civil.gg Eagles offense scheme screenshots (t398u attachments; images not committed).
owner_instruction.effect: Lions franchise and CPU games use a separate book that starts as a copy of the current shared civil scheme (the 49 callable variants after t414u, including PA Slide, red-zone Gun Bunch TE Mesh, and Pistol HB Zone / HB Dive) and then adds Gun Bunch TE Mtn Spacing 1-4 and Mtn Fork Y-Corner 1-3 with their setup steps and macro flags verbatim. Further owner plays dropped into this file change only Lions and CPU. Chiefs online and Titans franchise stay on the shared current book and never call the Mtn plays.

prior_instructions.effect: Added Mtn Spacing 1-4 and Mtn Fork Y-Corner 1-3 (plus PA Slide, red-zone Mesh, Pistol runs) to the shared civil catalog.

prior_instructions.statement: remove the mtn spacing and mtn fork y corner from the model you can leave the other plays in
prior_instructions.effect: Removed the 7 Mtn plays from the shared catalog (56 -> 49). That shared catalog is still what Chiefs and Titans use.

stock_source: cfb_coach/data/madden27/playbooks_full.json -> books.offense.Buccaneers.formations (exact names checked by the loader; owner-provided names that are not in the stock data are allowed only when listed under name_not_in_stock_data)
situation_tags_note: Down-and-distance tags were not transcribed from the screenshots; every new regular pass gets the same broad tags (1st And 10, Short, Medium, Long) so no situation is favored. Coverage tags follow the beater label.

cooldown_families.Mtn Spacing: new in the Lions/CPU book (Lions and CPU sessions have no play-family cooldown; Chiefs/Titans never see this family)
cooldown_families.Mtn Fork Y-Corner: new in the Lions/CPU book (Lions and CPU sessions have no play-family cooldown; Chiefs/Titans never see this family)

note: This file is layered onto the shared civil catalog (core 26 + t335u/t338u red zone + t349u/t398u designed runs + remaining t398u owner passes). It is not a standalone catalog. Empty future lists are placeholders for later Lions/CPU-only plays; do not invent names here.
